export declare const SCHEMA_DEF_NAMES: readonly ["OpaqueIdentifier", "HandoffWarrant", "LoginIdentifier", "AccountId", "OrganizationId", "LoginStateId", "OrganizationKind", "TenantRole", "TenantId", "MembershipStanding", "MembershipStandingResult", "ScopeLayerIdentity"];
export type SchemaDefName = (typeof SCHEMA_DEF_NAMES)[number];
export interface SchemaValidation {
    readonly valid: boolean;
    readonly errors: readonly string[];
}
/**
 * 按 `$defs` 名校验交换表示（S-22 一类的形状校验）。
 * 通过只说明形状合规，不表示任何条款成立（S-33）。
 */
export declare function validate(defName: SchemaDefName, value: unknown): SchemaValidation;
export declare const schemaId: string;
